lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Bonne Bouche,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: are you a regular at the Maid Cafe?
I don't think I would consider myself a regular...
Yes, I go there every day.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: You looked like one to me.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Every day?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Why is it then that whenever I ask what you're up to,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: you say you're busy?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Anyways,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: when the maids there drizzle the ketchup,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: did you know

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: that the taste differs depending on

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: who's doing it?
Really? Even if it's the same ketchup?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: The taste changes based on the emotions behind it.
How is it different, exactly?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Think about all the maids who drizzle the ketchup:

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Cocoa, Ade, Soda.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Imagine what kind of emotions they're feeling whilst drizzling the ketchup,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: and you'll know.
For Cocoa... tanginess.
For Cocoa... sweetness.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: That's correct.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Cocoa's ketchup has a bright and tangy flavor.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: One bite is enough to make you feel refreshed.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: You're quite something, Bonne Bouche!

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Not quite.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I'd say it's more of a bright and tangy flavor.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: One bite is enough to make you feel refreshed.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Sorry, Bonne Bouche, but your flavor deduction skills aren't quite there yet.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Next up we have Ade.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: What do you think her ketchup tastes like?
A classic ketchup taste.
Gentle and soothing.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Correct.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Ade's ketchup is remarkable in a different way.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: No one single flavor profile sticks out,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: but that's only because it's perfectly balanced.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Ade herself creates an environment that is gentle and soothing,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: but as for the taste she creates, that's a little different.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Ade's ketchup boasts the classic taste

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: that everyone associates with it.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: It's clean, crisp, and perfectly balanced.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: So I'd say you're only half right.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Lastly, we have Soda.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: What do you think?
Sweet.
A bit of a jumbled mess.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Hehe, you're right.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: The sweet taste you get as a result of Soda's affection is second to none.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: It really puts a smile on your face.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: I know Soda tends to cause a lot of trouble,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: but when she's cooking, she's more professional than anyone.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: She imbues her food with a sweet and joyful taste.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: So,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: as you can see, Bonne Bouche,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: the taste of the ketchup can differ depending on who is pouring it.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: So, next time you order an omurice at the Maid Cafe,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: try to really savor the ketchup,

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: and you'll see that what I'm saying is true.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Once you're attuned to it, you'll really be able to taste the difference.
I'll do that.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Or maybe...

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: You could also go with me sometime.

lines.speaker: bready
lines.text: Feel free to get in touch.
Hehe, all right.
